reviews.conclusion: Overworld eye measurement and return portal travel contain repeated game/settings/mouse/control menu holds, plus narrow rearranged capture at proxy 7.25-9 and 21.5-23.75 s. The visible menu bounds alone total 9.75-13.75 s, below the 14.067 s deficit; hidden pause state remains unknown. Ordinary capture/menu behavior is established, exact timing closure is unresolved.

This long bracket crosses several fresh timed attempts and a SeedQueue wall/benchmark phase. The current attempt changes to an empty-inventory overworld start near proxy 4 s; the SeedQueue wall runs from about 47-172 s; later another overworld timer reset appears near 337 s. Options, LAN configuration, narrow captures, and repeated instance switching also occur. The -8.8833 s offset cannot be interpreted as one uninterrupted run or exactly explained from this 1 fps proxy.

After dragon defeat, the exit portal gives black/dirt transition samples from proxy 3.5-7.75 s. In the overworld a game menu/Open to LAN screen appears at 10.5-11.75 s. Combined visible-state bounds are 5.5-6.5 s and contain the 5.783 s deficit, but Open to LAN can alter pause behavior. Ordinary post-run transition is visible; exact GUI accounting is unresolved.

The 1 fps bracket begins in a failed nether attempt, shows death at proxy 1-2 s and an empty-inventory overworld instance, then a large multi-instance selection wall from 20-121 s. An overworld start with tree/chest/mining/portal preparation follows, ending in nether entry. The comparison crosses attempt/instance-selection behavior and cannot be treated as an uninterrupted same-attempt edit measurement. Short menus may be missed at 1 fps; the 5.05 s deficit is not exactly closed.

Nether portal travel into a stronghold contains settings/video menus at proxy 2-3.5, 7-7.75 and 13.5-14 s. Their aggregate 2.75-4.25 s sample bounds contain the 3.275 s deficit. A later narrow capture at 15.25-15.5 s has unknown pause state, leaving exact accounting unresolved.

Bastion trading/mining contains three settings visits totaling 2.5-4.0 s, compatible with -3.2333 s. A horizontal compressed window for 1.5-2.0 s has unknown pause state. This is a long session proof: the visible attempt timer is only around 02:20 despite a source timestamp near 19 minutes. No attempt reset occurs inside this flag bracket; it cannot be assumed to belong to the submitted successful attempt.

Three pause/settings visits during bastion trading total 2.5-4.0 s, compatible with -3.0667 s. The source belongs to a long session and this visible attempt is around 02:00; its timer is lower than the earlier source clip, demonstrating different attempts across the recording. No reset occurs within this individual bracket. Chest/inventory management is not counted as paused.

The Nether attempt visibly switches to an empty-inventory overworld start near proxy 5 s, with the on-screen timer reset. Several more overworld/instance changes, black transition samples, and narrow game captures follow before the later Nether entry. Menus occur at proxy 39.25-40 and 94.25-95.25 s. Their duration is compatible numerically with -2.4 s, but a single continuous run-clock interpretation across these timed-attempt boundaries is unsuitable, so timing remains unresolved.
End entry is followed by game/settings/video menus at proxy 3.75-5.25 s, giving 1.5-2 s bounds compatible with the 1.758 s deficit. Inventory management afterward is not counted as pause time.
Bastion inventory use is followed by settings/skin menus at proxy 2.5-3.75 s. Their 1.25-1.75 s sampled bounds contain the 1.4 s deficit. Normal nether movement resumes afterward.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
